summary: Turbo Energy, S.A. filed a Form 6-K on May 11, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a strategic partnership with Inversiones Sandomac Limitada, a Chile-based family office, to expand Turbo Energy Solutions (TES) in Chile and Latin America. The transaction involves a strategic investment by Inversiones Sandomac Limitada in TES to support deployment of AI-driven Energy-as-a-Service infrastructure and SUNBOX Home residential energy systems. No specific financial terms (stake percentage, price, premium) or board recommendations are disclosed. The arrangement is a growth-focused partnership and investment, not a transformative corporate event. What to watch: further disclosure of investment terms and execution of expansion plans. Risk-arb angle: not applicable as this is not a transactional corporate event.
